method: Independent object-group observations from each exact canonical PNG, opened once. No crops, original SVG inspection, electromagnetism-convention reconstruction or new source approval.

groups.description: One small cartoon human at the left, facing toward the right-hand apparatus. Head/profile, clothed torso with dark chest/neck detail, arms, legs and footwear are visible. The feet overlap the platform's upper surface: this observer stands on the wheeled platform, left of the apparatus.
relationships: Observer on platform.
Observer left of apparatus.
Apparatus taller than the drawn observer.
unresolved: No name, nationality, sex, exact age, uniform identity or readable emblem is established from the cartoon.
Fine chest/neck clothing details are not identified as cultural symbols.

groups.description: A broad low rectangular platform in perspective, with repeated near-horizontal ruled/plank bands and a dark layered front edge. Two circular wheels are visible below the left and right portions. Both the observer and apparatus stand on this same platform.
relationships: Shared support for observer and apparatus.
Wheels below deck.
Ruled bands continue on both sides of occluding objects.
unresolved: Exact plank/band count is not certified because the observer and cylinder occlude portions.
The repeated bands are not assumed to be a coordinate grid or measured equal intervals.
Hidden wheels, axles and underside structure are not invented.

groups.description: A tall upright cylindrical-looking housing on the right of the platform. An elliptical top rim, two tall side outlines and curved bottom edge are visible. A narrow central vertical stem reaches upward toward the dark round object above the rim and extends into the body. A dark horizontal oval/sector-like shape is visible within the body around mid-height, with a detached dark triangular/arrow-like mark to its right; small broken marks occur near the upper-right interior.
relationships: Housing on platform.
Round object above top rim, aligned with central stem.
Internal dark shape within housing.
unresolved: The apparatus is not assigned a named generator, motor, electroscope or other device identity.
Whether the internal dark shape and adjacent triangle denote rotation, apparatus detail or another annotation is unresolved.
Stem attachment and rear/foreground occlusion are not promoted into unobserved electrical connections.

groups.description: One dark filled round object above the cylinder, at the common origin region of the radial arrow-like traces.
relationships: Above and centered approximately on the apparatus stem.
Radial traces originate near its boundary.
unresolved: No visible plus/minus charge sign, q label, voltage or numerical charge is present.
Charge polarity is not reconstructed from the outward arrows.

groups.description: Six radial arrow-like traces around the dark round object: upper-left, upper-right, horizontal left, horizontal right, lower-left and lower-right. Their visible arrowheads point away from the central region; the lower pair approach the apparatus rim. The stem below the object is recorded separately, not invented as a seventh field arrow.
relationships: Shared origin region at the round object.
Opposed left/right traces.
Upper and lower diagonal pairs.
unresolved: Exact endpoint coordinates and every lower-arrow/stem/rim crossing remain unverified.
No magnitude or equality of field strengths follows from drawn arrow lengths.

groups.description: One E-shaped capital glyph above the round object, between the upper diagonal arrows.
groups.scriptIdentity: Pixels do not distinguish Latin E from an identical-shaped Cyrillic capital glyph; no source code point is inferred.
relationships: Glyph associated spatially with the radial traces.
groups.sourceGlyphPreservation: Retain this exact source-image binding and glyph location; no translation or relabeling is authored here.

groups.description: Two adjacent rightward arrow-like marks appear beneath the platform: a short broad dark mark to the left and a longer thin rightward arrow to the right.
relationships: Both below platform, pointing toward page right.
unresolved: It is not certified whether the left mark is a separate meaningful arrow, part of a stylized glyph, or a compound velocity annotation.
No v or other letter is invented; the marks are not assigned separate speeds or observer motion.

notObserved: No B-shaped field label or external B-loop group.
No numerical quantities, units, axes, ticks, scale or measurement grid.
No source caption or figure number inside the PNG.
No textual person identity or legible political/national symbol.

routing.reason: The observer-on-platform relation and natural scene/apparatus identity are instructional, not disposable decoration. Preserve them as semantic artwork, while field arrows, glyphs and resolved motion relationships use a deterministic overlay.
artworkLayerRequired: Wheeled platform and visible plank structure
Cylindrical apparatus and source-bound scene placement
deterministicLayerRequiredLater: Six E-field traces and their resolved endpoints

groups.description: One small cartoon human stands at the far left facing right toward the apparatus. The person is outside the platform: the deck's left edge begins to the right of the person's footwear, unlike fig101. Head/profile, dark neck/chest clothing detail, torso, arms, legs and footwear are visible.
relationships: Observer off platform and left of it.
Observer faces toward apparatus.
Observer and apparatus do not share a visibly drawn support surface.
unresolved: No ground baseline, ground contact mechanism or extra observer platform is drawn.
Name, nationality, exact age, sex, cultural clothing identity and readable emblem are not inferred.

groups.description: A rectangular low platform in perspective occupies the lower-right portion and supports the tall apparatus. Near-horizontal ruled/plank bands and a dark front/underside edge are visible. Two circular wheels appear below it.
relationships: Apparatus on platform.
Observer not on platform.
Wheels below deck.
Deck extends left and right of the apparatus.
unresolved: Exact band/plank count and portions behind the cylinder are not certified.
Do not replace the visible plank structure with an invented coordinate grid or a featureless panel.
Hidden axles, wheels and underside parts are not invented.

groups.description: A tall upright cylindrical-looking housing is on the platform, with an elliptical top rim, side outlines and curved lower edge. A central narrow stem runs toward the round dark object above the rim and into the body. A dark horizontal oval/sector-like shape and a separate small dark mark are visible internally around mid-height; short broken marks appear near the upper-right interior.
relationships: Housing on platform.
Round object above rim on the stem alignment.
Dark internal shape within housing.
unresolved: No exact apparatus identity or circuit connection is reconstructed.
Meaning and precise topology of internal dark shapes and right-side broken marks remain unresolved.
Do not assume a rotating mechanism or assign electrical terminals from electromagnetism convention.

groups.description: One dark rounded object above the housing, partially intersected/occluded by the radial and loop traces.
relationships: At the common central region of the external field traces.
Above apparatus stem.
unresolved: No plus/minus polarity, q label, charge value or voltage label is visibly established.

groups.description: Six radial arrow-like traces are visible around the central round object: upper-left and upper-right, horizontal left and right, and lower-left and lower-right. Horizontal traces pass through the loop-like region; lower traces approach the apparatus rim. The stem is not counted as an additional field arrow.
relationships: Common central origin region.
Horizontal pair intersects the B-loop-like outlines.
Lower pair near the rim.
unresolved: Exact marker endpoints and crossing/occlusion order through the central loop region are not certified.
The apparent outward radial form is not a source charge-polarity or numerical field-strength approval.

groups.description: Four distinguishable loop/arc-like outline groups lie along the horizontal field-trace region: two to the left of the central round object and two to its right. The outer groups are tall C-like arcs with direction-marker-like features; the inner groups are smaller oval/loop-like outlines, partly merged with the horizontal and central traces.
relationships: Two left and two right of central region.
Loop-like outlines cross/surround the horizontal radial traces.
B-shaped glyphs lie outside the group on the left and right.
unresolved: Four outline groups do not prove four fully closed loops.
Exact closure, front/rear segmentation, circulation-arrow directions and central crossing topology are unresolved.
Do not reconstruct them with a right-hand rule, boost convention or presumed magnetic-field direction.

groups.description: One E-shaped capital glyph above the round object; two B-shaped capital glyphs outside the magnetic loop-like region, one left and one right.
groups.scriptIdentity: Raster shapes alone do not establish Latin versus identical-shaped Cyrillic code points. No exact source script identity is inferred or changed.
relationships: Top glyph associated with radial traces.
Left/right glyphs associated spatially with the corresponding loop-like groups.
groups.sourceGlyphPreservation: Exact original-image SHA and each glyph's observed location remain the authority; no replacement character, translation or new label is authored.

groups.description: A broad rightward arrow-like annotation appears below the middle of the platform.
relationships: Below platform.
Page-right direction.
unresolved: No velocity letter, numerical speed or separately drawn observer-motion arrow is inferred from the mark.

notObserved: No numerical quantities, units, axes, ticks, coordinate grid or dimensions.
No textual identity of the observer or apparatus.
No source caption or figure number inside the PNG.

routing.reason: The observer outside the moving apparatus platform is essential scene meaning. Natural human/platform/apparatus artwork must be preserved, while E/B traces, glyphs, motion direction and resolved positional relations require deterministic construction.

Cylindrical apparatus and source-bound scene placement

crossFigureRelationship.sourceObservation: In fig101 the observer is on the same platform as the apparatus; in fig102 the observer stands outside it at the left. Both drawings show rightward marks below the wheeled platform.
crossFigureRelationship.textContextReused: D844/D849 describe a stationary charge in its electrostatic rest-frame model and generally an additional magnetic component for a moving charge in another frame, with position/direction qualifications.
